noeuds.role: Teleports or pushes the object to new X and Y coordinates.
Clones the requested Model object and makes it appear. Available attached to a Target or at a fixed Position (X, Y).
Instantly creates and launches an object from the target in a direction.
Permanently removes the object, or all objects with a tag, from the scene.
Updates the visual fill of a progress bar (e.g. health bar).
Groups the Change Z-Order, Change Image, Color Filter, Opacity and Blend Mode nodes to change how your sprites look.
Keep on screen (invisible wall) and Wrap around screen (Pac-Man effect) to control the game boundaries.
